query_text_zh: 做个筹款活动web应用给桌面浏览器用。带着真正的温暖和目的感，让捐赠者感到他们的贡献很重要，不仅仅是交易。顶部有清晰的故事区，一个实时进度条显示筹款距目标有多近，下面是简单的捐赠表单。

query_text: An advocacy campaign tracker for desktop browsers, the kind of app that feels like it belongs to a cause and not a corporation, where supporters can read the core message, sign onto the campaign, and see a running count of people who have already joined, with the whole thing having a focused identity that makes the cause feel real and worth joining.
query_text_zh: 个倡议活动追踪器给桌面浏览器用。感起来像属于某个事业而不是企业。支持者能读核心信息、加入活动、看已加入人数的实时计数。整个应用有专注的身份感，让事业感觉真实值得加入。

query_text_zh: 做个博物馆礼品店web应用给桌面浏览器用。访客能按分类浏览纪念品和印刷复制品，每样有清晰的照片和价格，能加入购物车。这样就算离开场地也能买东西，不用再单独记得礼品店网址。

query_text: Build a hackathon site as a web app where teams can submit their project with a name, description, and demo link, and visitors browsing from a desktop browser can see all the submitted projects in a list with basic info, plus there is a simple voting or liking thing so people can show which projects they think are cool.
query_text_zh: 做一个黑客马拉松的网页应用，团队可以提交他们的项目包括项目名称、描述和演示链接，从桌面浏览器访问的人可以看到所有提交的项目列表和基本信息，还有一个简单的投票或点赞功能，这样人们可以表示他们认为哪些项目很酷。

query_text: A donation and sponsor tracker app for my open source project that lives in a desktop browser, where I can log each donation or sponsor with the amount, date, and a name or alias, see a running total on the main screen, and have a simple public-facing page that shows my supporters so I can thank them without maintaining a separate spreadsheet.
query_text_zh: 为我的开源项目做一个捐赠和赞助追踪应用，可以在桌面浏览器里用，我可以记录每笔捐赠或赞助的金额、日期和捐赠者的名字或昵称，首页显示运行总额，还有一个简单的公开页面展示我的支持者这样我可以感谢他们而不需要维护一个单独的电子表格。

query_text: Make a web app for managing Pro version subscriptions, where I can set up a few plan tiers with their prices and features listed side by side so users can compare them at a glance on a desktop browser, and when someone picks a plan it shows a simple checkout summary page with the plan name and total before they confirm.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用来管理Pro版本订阅，我可以设置几个价格等级，在桌面浏览器上并排显示它们的价格和功能清单这样用户可以一目了然地比较，当用户选择一个价格等级时，会显示一个简单的结账摘要页面，上面有价格等级名称和总价供用户确认。

query_text: Make a technical documentation and wiki app for desktop browsers where I can organize articles into categories, each article has a title and a body with headings, and there is a table of contents on the side that updates as I scroll through a long page, plus a search bar at the top so I can find any article by keyword quickly.
query_text_zh: 做一个技术文档和wiki应用专为桌面浏览器设计，我可以把文章按类别组织，每篇文章有标题和带有标题的内容体，侧边有一个目录在我滚动长页面时会自动更新，顶部还有搜索栏可以快速按关键词查找任何文章。

query_text: Create a web app that works as an API reference browser, where each endpoint is listed in a left sidebar grouped by resource type, clicking one shows the full details on the right including the method, path, request parameters, and a sample response, so I can look things up on a desktop browser without hunting through a long document every time.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用用来作为API参考浏览器，每个接口在左侧导航栏里按资源类型分组列出，点击一个接口就在右侧显示完整详情包括方法、路径、请求参数和响应示例，这样我可以在桌面浏览器里快速查找东西而不用每次都翻长文档。

query_text: A developer forum and BBS website built for desktop browsers, where anyone can post a thread under a topic category, others can reply in a threaded way, and the home screen of the app shows the latest active threads with the category label, poster name, and reply count so you can scan what is going on without clicking into everything.
query_text_zh: 做一个为桌面浏览器设计的开发者论坛和BBS网站，任何人都可以在某个话题类别下发帖，其他人可以按线程方式回复，应用的首页显示最新活跃的帖子，还有类别标签、发帖人名字和回复数，这样你可以快速扫一眼整个论坛不用一个个点进去。

query_text: Create a Q and A site as a web app for developers, where anyone can post a question with a title and description, others can post answers, and the person who asked can mark one answer as the accepted one, all in a clean layout on desktop browsers with questions listed by most recent or most votes on the home screen of the app.
query_text_zh: 做一个为开发者准备的问答网站网页应用，任何人都可以用标题和描述发布一个问题，其他人可以发布答案，提问者可以把某个答案标记为被采纳的答案，整个布局在桌面浏览器上很清爽，首页显示最新的或投票最多的问题。

query_text: Build a web app that is an experimental interactive playground where visitors can try out a few little demos or effects I built, each one lives in its own spot on the page, clicking it lets you mess around with some inputs and see the result change live, and the whole thing runs in a desktop browser so I can share the link with people to show what I am tinkering with.
query_text_zh: 做一个网页应用作为实验性的交互式游乐场，访客可以尝试我制作的几个小演示或效果，每个都占据页面上的一个位置，点击它可以让你摆弄一些输入参数并实时看到结果变化，整个东西在桌面浏览器里运行，我可以把链接分享给别人来展示我在折腾什么。

query_text: A browser-based tool site that brings together a handful of small utility calculators I use all the time, like a color converter, a time zone difference checker, and a text character counter, all on one website where I can pick the tool from a left-hand list and use it in the main area on a desktop browser without jumping between random sites.
query_text_zh: 一个基于浏览器的工具网站，集合了我经常用的一些小实用计算器，比如颜色转换器、时区差异检查工具和文本字符计数器，所有工具都在一个网站里，我可以从左边的列表选择一个工具然后在主区域使用它，在桌面浏览器上不用在不同的网站之间跳来跳去。
